Completion hash identifies the original simulator audit line, including its newline; no runner journal was synthesized.
Last physical ACK flags are preserved separately; the original native result supplies final score and success.
Public configuration is an allowlisted projection of the original private configuration.
Source and collection receipts require trusted provenance; public checks are not remote attestation.
Original video bytes are preserved; browser playback has not yet been verified.
